package gateways

import (
	"context"
	"strconv"
	"time"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	rules "example.test/gwapp/internal/rules/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/gwapp/internal/storage/queries/gateways"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgtype"
	"github.com/plutoframework/pluto-core/pagination"
)

const machine = "gateways.Gateway"

// Store is the authored gateway adapter. It never writes the machine key or
// state columns: registration relies on the column defaults, and rotation and
// revocation are generated scope.Tx methods.
type Store struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewStore(db scope.DB) *Store { return &Store{db: db} }

// Create inserts a pending gateway and mints its enrollment token in the same
// transaction.
func (s *Store) Create(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.NewGateway,
) (models.CreatedGateway, error) {
	var out models.CreatedGateway

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		id, err := queriesOf(tx).CreateGateway(
			ctx,
			queries.CreateGatewayParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), Name: in.Name},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		token, _, err := tx.IssueEnrollment(ctx, machine, id)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.CreatedGateway{ID: id, Token: token}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

func (s *Store) Rename(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.RenameGateway,
) (models.GatewayInfo, error) {
	var out models.GatewayInfo

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		row, err := queriesOf(tx).RenameGateway(
			ctx,
			queries.RenameGatewayParams{
				OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
				ID:    in.ID,
				Name:  in.Name,
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.GatewayInfo{
			ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, State: row.State, Online: row.Online,
		}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

func (s *Store) Revoke(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.GatewayRef,
) (models.GatewayRef, error) {
	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		return tx.RevokeMachine(ctx, machine, in.ID)
	})

	return in, err
}

func (s *Store) Rotate(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.GatewayRef,
) (models.CreatedGateway, error) {
	var out models.CreatedGateway

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		token, _, err := tx.RotateMachine(ctx, machine, in.ID)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.CreatedGateway{ID: in.ID, Token: token}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

// Beat updates the verified machine's own row: the tenant and the machine id
// come from the transaction, never from the request.
func (s *Store) Beat(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.Beat,
) (models.Ack, error) {
	var out models.Ack

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		seq, err := queriesOf(tx).Beat(ctx, queries.BeatParams{
			OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
			ID:    tx.SubjectID(),
			Seq:   in.Seq,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.Ack{Seq: seq}

		return queriesOf(tx).RecordBeat(ctx, queries.RecordBeatParams{
			OrgID:     tx.Tenant(),
			GatewayID: tx.SubjectID(),
			Seq:       seq,
		})
	})

	return out, err
}

func (s *Store) Status(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.StatusRequest,
) (models.GatewayStatus, error) {
	var out models.GatewayStatus

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		row, err := queriesOf(tx).GatewayStatus(
			ctx,
			queries.GatewayStatusParams{
				OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
				ID:    tx.SubjectID(),
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		out = models.GatewayStatus{
			ID:      row.ID,
			Name:    row.Name,
			State:   row.State,
			Online:  row.Online,
			LastSeq: row.LastSeq,
			Echo:    in.Echo,
		}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

func (s *Store) History(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.HistoryRequest,
) (pagination.Page[models.BeatRow], error) {
	var page pagination.Page[models.BeatRow]

	after, err := afterID(in.Page)
	if err != nil {
		return page, err
	}

	err = s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		rows, err := queriesOf(tx).ListBeats(ctx, queries.ListBeatsParams{
			OrgID:     tx.Tenant(),
			GatewayID: tx.SubjectID(),
			After:     after,
			MaxRows:   int32(in.Page.FetchLimit()),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		beats := make([]models.BeatRow, 0, len(rows))
		for _, row := range rows {
			beats = append(beats, models.BeatRow{
				ID:  row.ID,
				Seq: row.Seq,
				At:  row.At.Time.UTC(),
			})
		}

		page, err = pagination.Finish(in.Page, beats, beatKey)

		return err
	})

	return page, err
}

// MarkStale marks the tenant's silent gateways offline.
func (s *Store) MarkStale(ctx context.Context, e scope.Execution) error {
	return s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		_, err := queriesOf(tx).MarkStale(ctx, queries.MarkStaleParams{
			OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
			Before: pgtype.Timestamptz{
				Time:  time.Now().Add(-rules.StaleAfter),
				Valid: true,
			},
		})

		return err
	})
}

func beatKey(beat models.BeatRow) pagination.Key {
	return pagination.Key{ID: strconv.FormatInt(beat.ID, 10)}
}

func afterID(request pagination.Request) (int64, error) {
	if request.After.ID == "" {
		return 0, nil
	}

	return strconv.ParseInt(request.After.ID, 10, 64)
}

// Get reads one gateway of the verified tenant by the path id. A row of
// another tenant is invisible under row-level security: not found.
func (s *Store) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.GetRequest,
) (models.GatewayInfo, error) {
	var out models.GatewayInfo

	err := s.db.Read(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		row, err := queriesOf(tx).GatewayStatus(
			ctx,
			queries.GatewayStatusParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), ID: in.ID},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return scope.NotFound(err)
		}

		out = models.GatewayInfo{
			ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, State: row.State, Online: row.Online,
		}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

// Edit renames the gateway named by the path id.
func (s *Store) Edit(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.EditRequest,
) (models.GatewayInfo, error) {
	var out models.GatewayInfo

	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		row, err := queriesOf(tx).RenameGateway(
			ctx,
			queries.RenameGatewayParams{
				OrgID: tx.Tenant(),
				ID:    in.ID,
				Name:  in.Body.Name,
			},
		)
		if err != nil {
			return scope.NotFound(err)
		}

		out = models.GatewayInfo{
			ID: row.ID, Name: row.Name, State: row.State, Online: row.Online,
		}

		return nil
	})

	return out, err
}

// ClearBeats deletes the heartbeat history of the gateway named by the path
// id; the gateway itself must be visible to the tenant.
func (s *Store) ClearBeats(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.ClearBeatsRequest,
) (models.GatewayRef, error) {
	err := s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		if _, err := queriesOf(tx).GatewayStatus(
			ctx,
			queries.GatewayStatusParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), ID: in.ID},
		); err != nil {
			return scope.NotFound(err)
		}

		_, err := queriesOf(tx).ClearBeats(
			ctx,
			queries.ClearBeatsParams{OrgID: tx.Tenant(), GatewayID: in.ID},
		)

		return err
	})

	return models.GatewayRef(in), err
}
